props.gloss_en: the school of R' Yannai: [the measure for carrying out] oil is enough to anoint a small limb of a day-old child
R' Shimon ben Elazar: oil -- enough to anoint a small limb, and a day-old child
R' Natan: oil -- enough to anoint a small limb
(entertained) the school of R' Yannai's measure is the subject of the dispute between R' Shimon ben Elazar and R' Natan
(entertained) R' Shimon ben Elazar means a small limb of a small child
(entertained) R' Natan means a small limb of an adult or a large limb of a child; but a small limb of a day-old child -- no
(dechiya) no -- everyone agrees that [oil enough for] a small limb of a day-old child does not suffice
(dechiya) R' Shimon ben Elazar holds a small limb of an adult and a large limb of a day-old child are alike
(dechiya) R' Natan holds a small limb of an adult -- yes; a large limb of a day-old child -- no
the baraita: R' Shimon ben Elazar says oil -- enough to anoint a small limb of a day-old child
